title: Agentic system
line: An agentic system, split into parts: 11 agents with separate roles, skills on demand and gates where a person decides.

facts.v: I designed it and maintain it
Eclipse backend, Eclipse-Web and my own demos
Claude Code, Codex and GitHub Copilot

film.alt: Isometric illustration: a building whose eleven lights answer one after another, one per agent.
film.label: Own illustration

ten.v: A general-purpose assistant on its own mixes scope, design, security and cost: it tends to assume, over-build and spend.
One owner per decision, discovery before code, written assumptions and gates with human approval.
In use in my repos, in a different shape in each one. Merging, publishing and spending are mine to authorise.

how.d: I ask for a change and Direction orders plan, scope and cost.
A short spec, with acceptance criteria and how to roll back.
Each role agent states its assumptions and loads the skills it needs.
Tests, typecheck, build and screenshots; another reviewer tries to refute every finding.
Merging and deploying need my explicit, separate authorisation.

decisions.why: Each agent has its decision table and there is an ownership matrix: every decision has a single owner.
Each agent loads the skill its table names for the concrete action, and context stays small.

decisions.t: Sonnet by default, Opus with reason
decisions.why: The larger model is used at justified milestones, with reason, deliverable and exit criterion recorded, and goes through the aesthetic gate.

more.p: Six gates, from G0 (sources and version) to G5 (merge and deploy, which I authorise). Every claim carries its evidence level: from E0, a document, to E4, real operation.

A finding comes with file, line and severity; another reviewer tries to refute it, and what survives gets fixed. Design adds a 7-axis rubric with binary blockers: focus, contrast, reduced motion and honesty.
The Eclipse backend follows the backend and cybersecurity profiles in Codex format; in Eclipse-Web the roles are steps of a single session; my own demos carry adapted copies.
